modules.title: 金额字段是数字还是文字，差别在哪
数据类型如何影响界面的输入与呈现

items.title: 数字类型
items.text: 输入时弹数字键盘；列表能求和、能比大小。金额、数量、库存都该是数字。

items.title: 日期类型
items.text: 手机弹出日期选择器，格式统一；能按时间排序和筛选。「自己输入日期」是文字，做不到这些。

items.title: 选项类型
items.text: 只能从固定的几个里选，比如「跟进中、已成交、已归档」。避免了每个人各写各的说法。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 类型是填写前的格式约定，数据校验是提交时的检查——类型挡住大部分格式问题，校验负责剩下的（比如邮箱格式完整）。「金额」是字段名，「数字」才是它的类型。手机号看起来是数字，但不需要求和，用文字类型更省事——判断标准是「以后要不要对它做计算」，不是「它长得像不像数字」。

lessonPractice.title: 报价工具里要「按日期远近排序」，日期字段用哪种类型最合适？

options.label: 日期类型
options.feedback: 对。日期类型才能按时间先后排序，手机上还会弹出日期选择器，避免格式混乱。

options.label: 文字类型，自己输入「3月2日」
options.feedback: 文字没法比较先后：「3月2日」和「12月1日」按文字排序会排错，格式也各写各的。

options.label: 数字类型，输入 0302 表示 3 月 2 日
options.feedback: 凑数字会丢失月份天数，排序和显示都不对；日期就该用日期类型。

en.title: The quote tool needs to "sort by date." Which type should the date field use?

options.label: A date type
options.feedback: Correct. A date type sorts chronologically and opens a date picker on phones, avoiding messy formats.

options.label: A text type, typing "Mar 2" manually
options.feedback: Text cannot be ordered in time: "Mar 2" and "Dec 1" sort wrongly as text, and formats drift.

options.label: A number type, entering 0302 for March 2
options.feedback: Packed numbers lose month and day information; sorting and display both break. Dates belong in a date type.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 检查一下字段类型：金额用数字、日期用日期选择、状态用固定的几个选项。现在金额好像是文字存的，求和不了；改完类型后试试求和和按日期排序。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Check the field types: amount as a number, date as a date picker, status as a fixed set of options. Amount seems stored as text and cannot be summed; after fixing the types, try summing and sorting by date.

learning.assumes: You know some form inputs only accept digits and some open a date picker.
learning.outcome: You can assign a fitting type to each field in a list and name the cost of a wrong type (no summing, no sorting).

modules.title: Same field, different types, different abilities
How the type shapes what you see

items.title: Number
items.text: A numeric keyboard on entry; the list can sum and compare. Amounts, quantities, and stock should be numbers.

items.title: Date
items.text: Phones open a date picker with one consistent format; sorting and filtering by time work. Typing dates by hand is text and none of this works.

items.title: Choice
items.text: Pick from fixed options such as "following up / won / archived" instead of everyone wording their own.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A type is the format agreement before entry; data validation is the check at submit—the type blocks most format problems and validation catches the rest. "Amount" is a field name; "number" is its type. A phone number looks numeric but never needs summing, so a text type serves better—the test is "will I compute on it later," not "does it look like a number."

distinctions.label: Field
distinctions.text: {c:field} answers "what to record"; {c:data-type} answers "what format that information takes".

distinctions.label: Data validation
distinctions.text: {c:data-type} agrees on the format before entry; {c:data-validation} checks the submitted value against rules.
